adds.title: 2017 United States Department of State Human Rights Report on Timor-Leste
adds.summary: In 2017 in Timor-Leste same-sex sexual conduct was not criminalized but the law provided no protection against discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity, and transgender persons remained particularly vulnerable to societal discrimination, stigma and violence limiting access to employment, education and healthcare with no government action to prevent discrimination or violence.
